headline: ARI @ SFG matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 3.77 at SFG 3.22, with a projected total of 6.99. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: ARI moved -0.70 runs while SFG moved -1.17, changing the projected margin by +0.47 runs. The projected total fell -1.86, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +13.8%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Michael Soroka has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ketel Marte, Corbin Carroll, Casey Schmitt, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jose Fernandez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
